correctness.rationale: Nilpotent maximal ideal J ensures a canonical tangent idempotent on J/J². Rank-r linear projections number Gaussian-binomial(3,r)q^{r(3−r)}. For standard tangent ranks 1 and 2 the exterior anticommutation, square-zero and idempotence equations yield the complete displayed generator normal forms, with q³ and q⁴ free lifts. The rank-one image generator x+a xy+b xz+s xyz gives q³ distinct images for each tangent line; rank-two generating pairs have q^5 normal form choices modulo a free q² action by multiples of xy, giving q³ images per tangent plane. Explicit invertible-tangent generator substitutions show all images of each rank are automorphism-conjugate; canonical-image retractions number q² and q³. Independently implemented exterior wedge multiplication by bitmask with graded signs modulo 3, verified each of 3³ rank-one and 3⁴ rank-two displayed canonical projection retractions satisfies every exterior relation and e²=e. This is a consistency check, not a complete q3 enumeration; the proof’s normal-form exhaustion supplies all q.
